root.name: Philidor Defense: Albin-Blackburne Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 d6 3. d4 Bg4 4. dxe5 Nd7

overview: Black meets 3.d4 with 3...Bg4 and after 4.dxe5 Nd7 offers the e5 pawn for quick development, in the manner of the Blackburne Gambit. White can take 5.exd6 and Black recaptures on d6 or plays ...Bxf3, getting open lines but a pawn down. It is a rare try for activity.

white_ideas.idea: Keep the extra pawn and trade queens or a bishop

black_ideas.idea: Take back on d6 or play ...Bxf3 and ...Bxd6
Use the lead in development against the White king

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with White pawns on e4 and e5

character.notes: Black plays a gambit for activity so the position is tactical.

gambit.notes: White can keep the extra pawn on e5/d6.

soundness.notes: The gambit is seen as dubious for Black because White consolidates.

structure.notes: Pawns are exchanged in the centre.

character.reason: Black risks a pawn for quick development.

gambit.reason: Black offers the e5 pawn, which White can keep.

structure.reason: Central pawns trade and lines open.

plans.reason: Black plays for time and piece activity.
